935.synopsis:
Maria-sama ga Miteru’s story revolves around the students of the Lillian Catholic school for girls, and can be considered character-driven, focusing on interactions between the characters rather than any sort of ongoing plot or goal to attain. At Lillian Girls’ School, there is a tradition known as the sœur system (sœur being French for “sister” ) , in which a second, or third-year student, the grande sœur (“big sister” ) , will give her rosary to a junior student, the petite sœur (“little sister” ) , and promise to look after them and guide them.
When the story begins, Yumi Fukuzawa, a new first-year student admitted to Lillian, is praying in front of the virg*n Mary statue near the school entrance when she is suddenly approached by a cold second-year student named Sachiko Ogasawara who straightens Yumi’s uniform ribbon. This seemingly simple act of kindness stays with Yumi the rest of the day, and she speaks of her meeting with Sachiko to her friends during class and lunch. After school is over, Yumi’s classmate Tsutako Takeshima meets with Yumi to show her that she took a photograph of Yumi’s meeting with Sachiko earlier that morning. Yumi asks if she can have the photo, but Tsutako says she will give her the snapshot under two conditions: one being that Tsutako can display it at the upcoming school festival, and two being that Yumi get Sachiko’s permission to do so as well. Yumi agrees to this, which sets in motion a series of events involving the entire Yamayurikai — the student council of the school. A few weeks after first meeting Sachiko, Yumi accepts Sachiko’s rosary and therefore agrees to become her petite sœur.
This officially inducts Yumi into the Yamayurikai where she assists them in school matters at the same level as the other two petite sœurs — Yoshino Shimazu, and Shimako Toudou — who are the petite sœurs of Rei Hasekura, and Sei Satou respectively. Through her activities in the Yamayurikai, Yumi becomes closer to the other members and generally finds her experiences with the group to be enjoyable.
This was the original novel that the Manga and Anime are based on.

Determined to avoid the chain of tragedies that took his beloved ones away from him, he takes advantage of the advancements in swordsmanship and magic that developed during the war (as we all know, wars are when many scientific breakthroughs tend to happen), and tries his best to prepare for the demon invasion as well as strengthen himself with maximum efficiency.

1959.synopsis:
In the year 1989, the Japanese government passed the Media Betterment Act, allowing a group of soldiers known as the Media Betterment Committee (MBC) to destroy and censor any “problematic” media under the guise of protecting public morals. As a response, regional governments established the Library Defense Force (LDF), whose members take up arms and put their lives on the line to protect freedom of expression. At the top of the Kanto branch of the LDF stands the Library Task Force (LTF): an elite squad consisting of only the most exceptional fighters.
As a high schooler, Iku Kasahara experienced the terror of censorship first-hand when she refused to surrender the newest volume of her favorite series to MBC agents. She only came out unscathed thanks to a lone member of the LDF, who protected her and her beloved book. Now in her 20s and still unable to forget the man who saved her, Kasahara joins the LDF in the hope of becoming just like her prince.
But LDF training turns out to be far more rigorous than she could have imagined, and her instructor, LTF member Atsushi Doujou, seems fixated on making her life a living hell. Given her struggles, Kasahara is shocked when she is selected as one of the two new LTF recruits as a result of Doujou’s recommendation. As Kasahara does all she can to become worthy of the LTF and unravel her enigmatic superior’s motivations, she wages war—both on the battlefield and in her personal life.
Vol 1 – Toshokan Sensou (図書館戦争) (Library War)
Vol 2 – Toshokan Nairan (図書館内乱) (Library Infighting)
Vol 3 – Toshokan Kiki (図書館危機) (Library Crisis)

However, in the mysterious space Soujirou appeared in afterwards, there was a certain being that introduced itself as a [God] of a world. This [God] asked if Soujirou was interested in living a bit longer.
At that moment, together with his beloved katana, Soujirou consented to living in another world.
However, when it concerned getting the cheat ability commonly bestowed by an otherworld God– he was simply told, “there aren’t any cheats.” Sent to the other world, he was able to bring with him the talking sword, [Hotarumaru/Little Firefly], and the sword that took his life, [Sakura]. In addition, the only thing the [God] chose to bestow him was a button down shirt and parachute pants.
And so, in this other world, Soujirou was given a job called [Cursed Sword Master].
The [Cursed Sword Master], one who has the ability to bring out the personality of a sword.
Soujirou with his beloved swords in another world were able to meet with a beautiful girl named Sistina, who held the unique job of [Acolyte] a type of combat priest-maid.

Though Soujirou fights, he also enjoys having a relaxing time building an onsen, capitalizing on creating new items taken from the vast knowledge of Earth’s many light novels, starting up a new organization, and daring to try developing new and convenient items.

PS:
1. This is a fictional holographic close-quarters battle royale game with many imaginative elements. You don’t need to have played the game to enjoy the story.
2. Game skills and settings are inspired by games like “Eternal Punishment,” “Apex Legends,” “Overwatch,” and others.
3. The weapon master is invincible in close combat but terrible at using guns, while the archer never misses a shot. They pretend to be weak and rely on their spouse, the cunning world champion, to save them.

And someday, the world dubbed me the ‘One Man Army,’ calling me the Demon King. Then, “Saint, have I… lived in style?” “Yes, indeed, you’ve lived more stylishly than anyone else. I vouch for it.” Before saving the world and meeting my end, the saint acknowledged me, granting me a life more stylish than any other. But? It seems like I’ve been reborn as the youngest of a renowned swordsmanship clan. I’ve gained a family I never had before. I’ve gained trustworthy companions. So, why not continue living in style here as well?

76711.synopsis:
After the death of her parents, Sonia was taken in by her mother’s sister and her husband, but what awaited her there was a life of severe ab*se and confinement.
One day, after years of such confinement, there is a notification from the castle that the priests are coming to look for the saint.
The couple feared that the priests would find out that they had ab*sed Sonia, as they had also inherited Sonia’s parents’ property in exchange for taking her in.
The couple came to a conclusion―― to abandon Sonia in the forest where monsters roamed.
And like this, the story began to move. 
Which is to say.
The ab*sed girl became a saint――Unaware of her own overabundant misery.

79015.synopsis:
In the eternal winter of the Duke’s mansion, a cursed beast resides. The owner of the place and the male lead in the book, Duke Winternox. Carol became his night-guarding tutor.
Originally, she was destined to die entangled in his rampage. To survive, she should have avoided getting involved with him, but on the other hand, she also wanted to prevent his tragedy.
She only wanted to teach him that he was not the only one cursed, but what he learned from her was not just that.
“It’s hot and silent. I wonder what the teacher looks like?”
She read the longing contained in his fingers. And just like all the other female leads, Carol failed to train him.
“…You’ve got the wrong person.” 
“Got it wrong?”
The breath digging into her earlobe was hot.
“Remembering the moment I touched the teacher’s cheek, I thought about it every night.”
The voice, soaked in heat and cracked, bound her.
“How could I be mistaken?”

81319.synopsis:
A young man reincarnated into the world of the popular game ‘Brave of Astalisk’. However, his position was that of an insignificant mob gatekeeper named Silva, who had no connection with the main characters at all. 
Silva tried to live while keeping his distance from the main characters so as not to disrupt the scenario with his actions, but by chance, he ended up saving his ‘favorite’, Charlotte Oroland, from a crisis. 
Since then, Silva, who unintentionally became close to Charlotte, gradually gained recognition from the main characters, despite being a mere mob gatekeeper.
‘Please, let me just be a mob!’
Today, Silva’s plea echoes once again. However, he cannot ignore the approaching heroines—this is the story of the strongest mob living in the world of his beloved game.
associated_names: Game Chishiki De Saikyo Ni Natta Mob Heishi Ha, Shin No Jitsuryoku Wo Kakushitai

81831.synopsis:
“Chief, it’s bad; our people are injured! Hurry, take them to the Divine Tree!” 
“Chief, it’s bad; our people are on the brink of death, about to perish! Quick, to the Divine Tree!” 
“Chief, it’s bad; our people have just passed away! Quickly, to the Divine Tree, and do not let the body grow cold on the way!”
Reincarnated as a frail locust tree, Ji Yang merely wished to bask in the sun each day, gaze upon the moon, and live a leisurely life. 
Yet, years later, as Ji Yang looked down upon all beings, he suddenly realized that this world lay upon his roots and within his shade. 
And that initial small clan, unbeknownst to him, had its name resound through the heavens!

82087.synopsis:
Uchiha Natsuki acquires the Power System and revives the Uchiha Clan to create the strongest force in the Ninja World.
【No Romance】
【Focus on Ambitions】
【Uchiha with Intelligence】
 Excluding the Uchiha? Sorry, we’re done! Anyone can join the Police Force if they want! “Kakashi, White Fang’s death was orchestrated by Danzo, with the Third Hokage’s consent. And you’re still loyal to Konoha!?”
“Itachi, this time you’ll awaken the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan.”
“Haku, your combat skills are too weak. I’ll send you to the Tsukuyomi space for training.”
Sorry, but every Uchiha now has the Mangekyō Sharingan.
These days, who fights alone? Attack together! The Ōtsutsuki are coming to destroy the world, and you’re still vying for the Hokage position?

Danzo: “We cannot let the Uchiha gain power!”

83623.synopsis:
I was a supporting role player in the novel, Round.
I was smoothly playing the role of a background supporting character, but for some reason, the prickly sub male lead was unusually friendly.
To hold onto my star points and endure until the end, I had to accurately address this variable.
“Sir Kiriel, do you perhaps like me?”
His handsome face twisted.
“No.”
Relieved by his denial, I just focused on my work, but…
“Miss Kana, do you not like me?”
For some reason, his attitude became more serious and blatant.
…What’s going on, why is he suddenly acting like this?

84135.synopsis:
Yin Bei, the Fengdu Emperor, the Underworld Boss, and the Ambassador of Loneliness in the Three Realms, was announced by Yue Lao to be connected by the red thread of fate with Ao Jinyu, the little crown prince of the East Sea Dragon Palace—by the way of heaven.
The dragon was even still in its egg.
When the little golden dragon grew up, he thought that “the dragon generation in this new era should start with me rejecting arranged marriages,” so he packed up his bags and left home to travel around the human world on his own.
He ended up renting a two-bedroom apartment that belonged to Yin Bei.
Yin Bei looked at his new roommate, who had a backpack and a bright, innocent smile: …I guess I’ll just pretend to be human for now.
A few days later, Ao Jinyu, who was punching out bad spirits and kicking out evil ways, and Yin Bei, who nearly scared the wits out of malicious ghosts, met face to face on a narrow path.
Ao Jinyu: So you’re not human either! If you had said so earlier, I wouldn’t have had to pretend for so long!
Yin Bei: …Where on earth are you pretending?
Ao Jinyu: “Beibei——”
Yin Bei raised his eyes impatiently: “What is it now? Which family’s monster did you beat up again and need me to clean up?”
Ao Jinyu poured out a bag of fist-sized pearls onto his desk and leaned over eagerly: “Do you like them? It’s my family’s specialty.”
Yin Bei: “……”
Things seemed to be heading in an uncontrollable direction.
#Holding tightly onto my vest##It’s killing me that this dragon is greedy for my body##You ran away from marriage for nothing#
Ao Jinyu: “There’s a big age gap between me and him.”
Yin Bei: “You and I also have a very big age gap.”
Ao Jinyu: “Actually, I like older people! I was just being tsundere earlier!”
Ao Jinyu: “His reputation doesn’t seem very good.”
Yin Bei: “My reputation isn’t good either.”
Ao Jinyu: “I like cute and charming villains the most!”
Yin Bei: “…Heh, double standard dragon.”
The Simple-minded and the Unhappy
associated_names: As It Turns Out You're Not Human Either
Turns Out You're Not Human Either

84903.synopsis:
One-line summary: The male lead is initially an arrogant, noble, love-deprived brat, later a cute, clingy, scheming little jealous one.
Introduction:
One day, Lu Yuner’s soul transmigrates into a female-dominant world. She enters the Imperial Academy and takes up the position of a doctoral instructor, teaching classes and grading schoolwork.
One day, she encounters the young prince Su Qingwan secretly skipping class from the male academy.
As a result, Su Qingwan is punished.
From then on, Su Qingwan sees Lu Yuner as a “thorn in his side”.
But before long, this “thorn” becomes the person he cherishes most, and he goes to great lengths to win Lu Yuner’s affection.
Mini scene 1:
One day, the sun is high in the sky but Su Qingwan still hasn’t gotten up for class.
Servant Xiaoyuan: “Young prince, it’s time for class. You’ll be late otherwise.”
Su Qingwan says arrogantly: “I’m not going. I am the esteemed prince, my status is so noble, why should I suffer this hardship? Besides, isn’t learning all this just to please women? Hmph, they’re not worthy!”
Mini scene 2:
After Su Qingwan falls for someone, he completely changes. He no longer skips class and diligently learns how to be a good husband and father. But he discovers that Sister Yuner is always surrounded by admirers.
Drunk and overcome with jealousy one day, he clings to Lu Yuner, crying beautifully like a pear blossom in the rain.
Su Qingwan: “Qingwan likes Sister Yuner.”
Lu Yuner: “Young prince, you’re drunk.”
Su Qingwan: “Qingwan isn’t drunk. Qingwan likes Sister Yuner, likes you so much, likes you to bits…” Before he can finish, Lu Yuner’s eyes flash with emotion and she leans in closer.
[Reading Guide]
1. The female lead is gentle, gracious, humble and polite but not weak. The male lead is initially an arrogant, noble, love-deprived brat, later a cute, clingy, scheming little jealous one.
2. 1v1, a bit torturous in the beginning but definitely sweet later on.

88231.synopsis:
A cute, caring, and busty childhood friend in a mutual love. Shatter that illusion!
New semester of the second year.
I ended up in the same class as two interesting individuals.
The boy’s name is Iizuka Masato.
An introverted loner. In class, it’s unclear what he’s thinking, perhaps trying to appear aloof by building walls around himself.
The girl’s name is Suzumiya Kiyoka.
Fairly cute, with breasts quite assertive.
She seems quiet, always chatting cheerfully with her female friends.
What’s interesting about these two is that I often hear rumors that they’re childhood friends and are dating.
However, upon closer observation, they don’t seem to be dating at all.
Iizuka acts arrogant and boyfriend-like only in front of Suzumiya.
In contrast, Suzumiya seems bothered.
Usually, Iizuka is the only one initiating conversations, while Suzumiya rarely speaks to him and shows no signs of paying attention to him.
Yet, the classmates around them believe the two are close and dating.
I was enjoying observing these two, but somehow I, who was supposed to be just a bystander, got caught up in their commotion. That kind of romantic comedy.
associated_names: Freedom from the curse of childhood friends - I liked you first! I don't know what to do with you.

88999.synopsis:
A former baseball star who quit due to the shock of losing his polite Yandere little sister is reborn as a homewrecker in a baseball NTR game. Now, alongside his gal-type tsundere little sister (who in the game is set as his ‘friend-with-benefits’), he’s aiming for the championship, willing to use any means necessary!
But for some reason, his polite-speaking little sister, who was supposed to be dead, has reincarnated into the game world as well. She thinks this is just a baseball game, so there’s no way he can let her find out that he’s been playing an NTR game! Yet, this is his second chance to fulfill the promise he made to her while she was still alive: to take her to Koshien.
In this bizarre world shaped by the nature of the NTR game, he uses (in the worst ways possible) its elements to power through powerhouse schools. At the same time, he absolutely cannot let his sister find out!
However, something begins to change with the game’s main heroine, whom he never intended to steal, and the protagonist-kun, his junior in this world…
This is an intense love-comedy about two sisters fighting over their brother, combined with the story of an underdog baseball team’s domination, leveraging the NTR game elements to rise to the top!

91559.synopsis:
After achieving success, he grew curious.
What if he could live his life again?
This time, could he chase his dreams instead of success?
“Why not just succeed with your dream?”
Do Ji-won, the youngest ever Head of Strategic Planning, regresses back to his days as a PD.

92327.synopsis:
“Even if I am covered in thorns and my feet are in the mud,

95655.synopsis:
I possessed the body of a villain who torments the male protagonist in a tragic story and dies.
Before meeting the male protagonist, I managed to endure my miserable life with survival skills and magic.
When I finally met the male protagonist:
“Get lost.”
He bared his teeth like a kitten.
But as we got a little closer,
“Lila, help me.”
I worked hard to take care of this unexpectedly pitiable young master.
And then…
“Lila, do you love me?”
“What?”
“I’m asking if you love me.”
“…Young Master.”
“I love you.”
“…”
When I was too stunned to respond, he smiled and approached me.
“Lila, tell me you love me. If you do, I’ll give you everything I have. Okay?”
It seems I raised him too well.
The young master I had so carefully raised began to obsess over me.

96679.synopsis:
A National Treasure—a hero who rightfully deserved everyone’s respect. 
They were those who dedicated their bodies, minds and skills to protect the defense and honor of the nation. 
They were directly related to the nation’s strength.

96935.synopsis: The possibility of a nation being overtaken by demons—that dire situation was caused by none other than the Saint, whose duty it was to exorcise those demons, and my own fiancé.
associated_names: 神様、婚約者様と聖女様が不貞を働いたそうですが？

98215.synopsis:
Deep in the flowers lived a poor girl named Hua’er. Hua’er was a night watchman, and whenever the night fell, she would pick up a bamboo clapper with her slender hands and follow behind the guards, calling out to the dead souls. Second Master Bai was a light sleeper. Every time he tried to fall asleep, her trembling voice would enter his ears and disturb his rest. Unable to take it any longer, he eventually decided to marry her and bring her home, shut her up and have a peaceful night’s sleep.
Unexpectedly, when the matchmaker entered and barely even sat down, she was immediately driven away by the stubborn Hua’er: “I would rather marry anyone but that infamous Second Master Bai!”
Unable to write a proper summary, it perhaps shows this very bitter yet sweet story.
Thunder and rain, both are blessings from heaven.

98983.synopsis:
The news that Xu Fei Mo was to take up his new post in Suzhou had been shared with everyone.
Except for me, his fiancée.
He despised me for being foolish, for always clinging to him.
“This promotion was thanks to Senior Xu from Quzhou recommending me. I must pay him a personal visit to express my gratitude.
“As for Zhu Xiao Ying? No need to inform her. She’s like a dog. If she finds out, she’ll definitely sniff her way to Suzhou.”
I overheard this conversation and returned home, brimming with excitement, to pack my little floral bundle.
In the past, it was always him who left me behind. This time, I wanted to go to Suzhou first and wait for him.
When Xu Fei Mo arrived and saw how clever I was, he’d surely be stunned.
But the next day, when the boatman asked me where I was headed, I scratched my head, unable to recall.
Suzhou? Quzhou? Or was it Songzhou?
The boatman grew impatient, digging at his ears and preparing to shove me aside.
Afraid he might scold me like Xu Fei Mo did, I quickly pressed some silver into his hand and nodded ingratiatingly.
“Quzhou, I’m going to Quzhou.”

99239.synopsis:
After “retiring,” Xue Changyi, one of the Ten Yama Kings, arrives in the parallel world’s Jixia Academy—Underworld High School—to become a substitute homeroom teacher.
Xue Changyi is proficient in burning livers, skinning and boning, and capturing souls. He has killed, beheaded, and judged, but… he’s never been a teacher.
Underworld High School, Class Nine, the legendary experimental class.
Class President Qin Shi Huang, Study Committee Member Zhuge Liang, and troublemaker Lü Bu.
Liu Bei from the next class comes by daily to sell straw sandals; the poet Li Bai attends class every day with a wine pot and sword; and there’s also the tyrant Emperor Yang of Sui, now a classmate, and his beloved father, Emperor Wen of Sui, making parent-teacher conferences incredibly convenient…
Yang Guang, the Sui Emperor, who hasn’t turned in his homework: “I am the Son of Heaven, the True Dragon Emperor! Do you dare strike my hand with a ruler?!”
Substitute homeroom teacher Xue Changyi blinks: “We can skip the ruler.”
Yang Guang sneers.
Xue Changyi ponders for a moment, then takes out his Divine Striking Whip: “Spanking, however, is an option.”
Yang Guang: “…”
One day, in addition to selling straw sandals, Liu Bei expands his business—selling best-selling novels!
Underworld R1800+ rating, annual sales TOP1!
For 200 consecutive years, the reigning sales champion!
Highly recommended by the poet Li Bai, a mysterious and forbidden love story!

100007.synopsis:
After his beloved’s death in a car accident, Xie Zhang spends every day with his lover’s violin, the tension in his heart stretched to the breaking point.
Until one day, his shadow comes to life.
The shadow likes to mold itself into different shapes in the sunlight;
It urges him to go to bed early;
It teases cats and dogs and then hides behind him with impunity;
It can even play the violin quite well—
Its playing style is identical to his lover’s.
Xie Zhang accepts the reality that he is ill.
Calmly, and matter-of-factly.
Because…
Xie Zhang stands in front of the mirror, watching the little shadow shape itself into a cat’s head, holding a brooch against his chest, his eyes filled with laughter and contentment.
Look, his wish has been granted.
His beloved will finally never be separated from him again.
***
After the car accident, Song Jingmo wakes up to find himself turned into a shadow.
Good news: he has become the shadow of his beloved, Xie Zhang.
Bad news: Xie Zhang firmly believes he’s gone insane.
Song Jingmo tries everything, from late-night violin serenades to shadow puppet cat heads… The result is that Xie Zhang becomes more and more convinced of his own illness.
Watching Xie Zhang address his mirror as “darling” every day, Song Jingmo is at a loss for words.
Finally, one day, Xie Zhang sees a psychiatrist.
The psychiatrist prescribes medication with a strange look on his face.
Xie Zhang prepares to take the medicine.
Song Jingmo curses the quack doctor in his mind, even preparing to reach out and dig into Xie Zhang’s throat.
The next second, he watches in disbelief as Xie Zhang pours the medicine down the toilet, smiling and confessing his love to the shadow: “Don’t worry, darling, I will never leave you.”
Song Jingmo: “…”
Firstly, he is indeed Xie Zhang’s darling.
Secondly, Xie Zhang’s shadow really has come to life.
Lastly, how can he make Xie Zhang understand that he’s not actually sick?!

101031.synopsis:
One drunken night, my friend blurted out something absurd.

A few hundred years have passed since dungeons first appeared in the world. Over time, jobs and skills became systematized, allowing adventurers to grow stronger in a structured way.
One day, the protagonist unexpectedly finds himself assigned to an unusual and seemingly strange job. Determined not to be stuck with this fate, he embark on a journey to overcome challenges, uncover hidden truths about the job system, and ultimately obtain a “proper” and respectable profession.

106663.synopsis:
Qin Ran’s muse died, and so did his art. Running out of inspiration, he accidentally stumbled into a mysterious mountain village after a car accident, where he met a blindfolded beauty with a face as cold as ice, and was captivated by him at first sight. 
In order to get a new source of inspiration, Qin Ran relentlessly pursued the beauty using every means possible, but the beauty rejected him coldly.
Later, they got married in the village. Qin Ran grew bolder and tried to use himself as bait to trick him into going back to the city with him, only to discover that the beauty he shared the bed with was not a human being at all. He wanted to escape, but it was already too late—
“Ranran, didn’t you want to draw me?”
“Ranran, didn’t you say you wouldn’t abandon me?”
“Ranran… you should call me husband.”

111527.synopsis: The only reason I held onto this meaningless life so tenaciously was because of my one younger sibling, who is not related by blood.

111783.synopsis:

113319.synopsis:
Shen Yan had no idea what kind of sin he had committed to suddenly awaken such an utterly embarrassing superpower—

113831.synopsis:
Always followed the rule of only dating without ever falling in love, and navigated with ease among all kinds of high-quality men—those with outstanding family backgrounds, exceptional looks, and remarkable abilities.
One day, she transmigrated. In order to survive, she resolutely embarked on a thrilling journey of turning s*umbags’ lives into a strategy hell and chasing wives straight into a crematorium of regret.
But wait—
1: The expendable stand-in for the tragic heroine in a tortured white moonlight romance.
2: The unavenged fairy of the Medicine Valley, completely used and discarded by s*umbags and ungrateful wolves.
3: The tormented side character in a boys’ school romance who lost everything.
4: The cold-hearted, black moonlight of a young wolfish male lead.
5: Spent ten years supporting a broke man from nothing to billionaire status. When he reunited with the gold-digging ex who had abandoned him, he claimed it was revenge—yet spoiled her sweetly all the way to their happily-ever-after. Meanwhile, she ended up in prison.

115367.synopsis:
Li Luo was one of the humble mortals the gods swore to protect.
She was the mountain villager who died during the divine maiden’s tribulation in the mortal world, tragically caught in a love triangle between the Demon Lord and the God of War. When the two men succumbed to jealousy and rage, their battle destroyed heaven and earth—taking her life with it.
She was one of the millions burned alive in a sacrificial fire meant to save the realm, when a fairy and a Demon King’s absurd love spanned three lifetimes, ending in betrayal, slander, and catastrophic revenge.
She was one of the people slaughtered when the Divine King, on the path of emotionless cultivation, killed his wife to prove his Dao, then regretted it, went mad trying to win her back, and finally fell into darkness. In his descent, he learned his white moonlight had moved on, and in his madness, he razed an entire city to the ground.
Once.
Twice.
Thrice.
Countless times.
Li Luo watched again and again as these immortals spun themselves into tragic love triangles, love squares, love pentagons—obsessive, painful romances that ended with them going insane, slaughtering the innocent, and destroying city after city.
Then they’d say something like, “For the sake of the mortal realm, I sacrificed myself for the greater good,” and just die then come back to life. Everyone would forgive each other, let bygones be bygones, live happily ever after, and embrace love and joy???
They died or lived as they pleased—but what about all those humble mortals who had died by their hands?
She was sick of it. Might as well burn it all down.
Li Luo lay on the scorched wasteland the gods had left behind, inhaling the stench of rotting corpses, and closed her eyes.
Then, the moment she opened them again, she was back in the first life. She had to endure it all again from the beginning.
It was simply—
Intolerable. Unbearable.

119975.synopsis:
Dying in an accident and waking up, I found a handsome man chained in an unfamiliar penthouse.
[What’s the problem, seriously? I paid off your debt, provided a place to sleep, and offered to buy you anything you want… I really don’t understand.] 
[Bullshit…! That debt was all part of your plan…! Cough!] 
Rummaging through my memories, it wasn’t hard to deduce that I was tr*sh.
To get Hankyeom, I shattered his perfectly normal home under the guise of redevelopment investment,
and even touched his friends—there was no corner I didn’t mess with.
As a result of my efforts to help Hankyeom grow into a free, independent adult, starting now…
“Now you’re being nice… Did you think I’d actually fall in love with you?”
No, why am I being treated like an obsessive tyrant on a regret route?!
Stop it! When you say things like that, people always fall in love! Please stop with those cliché lines!!
My heart raced, so I offered him money, found him a job, and even a house, telling him to leave, but then,
“You said you loved me?”
No, why is he hurt…?

133799.synopsis:
Aniella lost her mother at a young age. She received encouragement from her stepmother and stepsisters.
“You must catch a wealthy man at this ball! You are our family’s hope!”
Despite her family’s cheers, Aniella ended up nodding off at the ball. It was because she had worked herself to death to earn the money for the exorbitantly expensive dress.
Ding-dong. When she woke to the sound of the clock chiming, it was already 12 o’clock, her father’s set curfew.
“I was just about to head back myself, so let me give you a ride.”
Fortunately, Duke Paiki showed her kindness. She had heard he was the emperor’s henchman who engaged in blackmail and threats and had thrown his morality to the dogs, but surprisingly, he seemed like a nice person!
Reassured, Aniella dozed off again in the carriage she had managed to get a ride in. But when she opened her eyes, wouldn’t you know it, she was imprisoned in some unknown place.
“I want to conduct research on what could make you lazy.”
Duke Paiki—he was a kind-hearted lunatic.

139687.synopsis:
[Anti-cliché + Silly + Power Fantasy] 
Qin Fan transmigrated into a cannon-fodder villain. Right at the start, he was caught red-handed—spying on his Second Senior Sister while she bathed, and even had her underwear found in his robe!
A setup for execution? Not at all!
He was suddenly granted the [Strongest Villain System] ! But… the activation condition was: being expelled from the sect?
And so, he recalled his miserable fate—being the designated stepping stone, errand boy, scapegoat, and punching bag for the Heaven’s Chosen one, Ye Chen!
Qin Fan dropped all pretenses on the spot!
Revenge was taken on the spot, injustice confronted face-to-face!
“That’s right! I stole the undergarment!”
“Yes! I’m a depraved pe*vert!”
“I’m a vile degenerate! A wicked criminal! What are you waiting for? Hurry up and expel me from the sect already!”
Master Yuquan Zhenren said, “Expel him from the sect? Are you joking? I wouldn’t dare!”

152487.synopsis:
Si Shaotang died a gruesome death.
Her tongue was ripped out, her eyes gouged, her tendons severed, and her bones shattered. Like a wild dog, her corpse was tossed onto a mass grave.
Meanwhile, her so-called good sister, Yao Ying, stood atop her bones, ascending to the throne of the Immortal Sect’s top disciple.
Reborn, Si Shaotang no longer bothered pretending to be meek and obedient. She clung to the leg of Nian Yuzhu, the Sword Pavilion’s top disciple, forcing her way into the Crossing Immortal Sect’s new disciple ranks.
The Crossing Immortal Sect soon discovered that the newly arrived, taciturn sword-obsessed junior sister, aside from fawning over the Eldest Senior Sister, always regarded others with a mixture of mockery and hostility.
Yao Ying wanted to break through using a dual cultivation technique? Si Shaotang secretly slipped Joyful Union Powder into her victory celebration banquet.
Her master, feigning concern while coveting her Innate Spirit Bone? Si Shaotang directly caused the old man’s Nascent Soul to go berserk in front of everyone.
The sect wanted to sacrifice her to activate the Mountain-Protecting Formation? Fine. She would let the formation backfire and see who ended up being sacrificed in the end.
Until that day, Nian Yuzhu, the Sword Pavilion’s top disciple, cornered her at the edge of the sword-training cliff. Her voice was as cold as ice: “Si Shaotang, have you had enough fun?”
Nian Yuzhu’s longsword was already pressed against Si Shaotang’s heart.
Si Shaotang tilted her head and chuckled. “Eldest Senior Sister, are you… cleaning up the sect?”
At Yao Ying’s birthday banquet, after three rounds of wine, she was utterly drunk. Before everyone’s eyes, she brazenly flirted with the sect elders, her words flippant and her behavior wanton, causing a wave of shock throughout the hall.
Everything unfolded exactly as Si Shaotang had predicted.
Leaning against a pillar, a hint of mockery flashed in her eyes. Seeing Yao Ying stumble away after being struck, she silently followed.
Inside Yao Ying’s residence, the drug took effect. Her face flushed crimson, her clothes disheveled as she writhed and moaned on the floor, no trace remaining of her usual haughty demeanor. Si Shaotang watched coldly until Yao Ying’s humiliation was complete, then found the spectacle utterly boring.
A single blade stroke ended her suffering.
Just as Si Shaotang turned to leave, a familiar low moan suddenly echoed from the inner chamber.
“Mmm…”
Gripping the hilt of her blade, Si Shaotang entered the secret room. Her pupils dilated sharply as she saw the figure on the jade bed.
Nian Yuzhu’s usually pristine cloud-patterned white robes were in disarray, her raven hair cascading across the jade bed like a waterfall.
Her jade-like face, always cold and aloof, was now flushed with feverish color, her thin lips bitten until blood beaded at the corners.
Sensing someone approaching, Nian Yuzhu struggled to sit up, her fingertips clawing at the bedsheets until her knuckles turned white. Panting, she raised her unfocused gaze, yet still clung to the last vestiges of her clarity.
Si Shaotang froze in place.
She had never seen her Eldest Senior Sister like this before.
Vulnerable, disheveled, yet… breathtakingly beautiful.
In that moment of hesitation, a scorching force suddenly seized her wrist!
The world spun as she was pulled down onto the jade bed. Nian Yuzhu loomed over her, her hot breath brushing against Si Shaotang’s ear, her voice hoarse and unrecognizable.
“Xiao Si…”
“Help me…”
Key Point: Many readers have been asking about the “Young Master Si” mentioned in the first chapter. To clarify, the protagonist is disguised as a man to make the story more realistic, as she is fleeing famine. Her true identity will be revealed in the second chapter after the crisis is resolved.

After five years of partnering with the close quarters combat specialist Chishu (Alpha), long-range sniper Crecence (Alpha) still finds their relationship as hostile as ever.
However, that doesn’t stop Crecence from seeking Chishu out for some “intimate exercise.” After all, Yan Xueting—the Federation’s top sniper next door, told him that this is the best way to increase the synchronization rate between mecha pilots! Whether it actually works or not, Crecence figures he has nothing to lose by trying.
Seizing the opportunity, Chishu proposes that they start dating.
In bed, clutching his aching waist, Crecence insists: “This is only for the sake of piloting! It’s for scientific research!”
Soon, rumors begin to swirl around the interstellar base that Chishu is deeply in love with Crecence. Crecence responds with a “s*umbag” attitude, declaring: “That’s none of my business. I never asked him to like me!”

Chishu thinks to himself: I wonder who that person was, blushing and sobbing in my arms every night lately? Chishu decides that tonight, he’ll have to go a few more rounds. Sooner or later, he’ll make sure that mouth of his softens up, too.

Song Pu transmigrates into a melodramatic ancient-romance novel and ends up as a minor cannon-fodder character serving at the side of a villainous tyrant.

When he opened his eyes again and faced the family who blindly protected the adopted son, Chen Mo decided to sever all ties with the Chen family and live a different life.
However, the Chen family simply refused to let him go.
“Since we’ve already cut ties, why are you still kneeling and begging me?”

The mere fact that the emperor had gifted his precious sister risqué underwear was utterly unpleasant.
However, Eren’s problem was that he had to wear it instead of his sister.
His sister, chosen as the Saintess, had received a divine oracle that she must marry the tyrannical emperor and bear his child.
But on the day of the wedding, his sister disappeared.
In his past life, his entire family had been executed because his sister, the Saintess, had disappeared.
Having somehow regressed to that day, Eren could not let himself die in vain this life.
‘To think something like an omega was born into our Whaleton family.’
Something like an omega…
When a male omega was born, the family was said to have sinned against the gods and would be punished along with him, or in some cases, have their title revoked.
For that reason, he had to live his entire life in hiding.
He had no life of his own. Therefore, Eren wanted to survive at all costs and live as the real ‘Eren Whaleton’. He wanted to prove that even as an omega, he could fulfill his worth.
“If I must, I will do anything. If you wish it, I will even bear Your Majesty’s child.”

207271.synopsis:
The summer was long and tedious, the moonlight faded like plain boiled water.
Yun Huizhi lazed about the town, taking photos and writing articles, volunteering as its promotional ambassador.
One day, she posted a landscape photo with an unhinged caption: “Amateur Tour Guide. If you want to travel and are looking for a short-term girlfriend, consider me. Prices negotiable (Pretty women only).”
Someone sent her a private message asking about her standard for “pretty.” Yun Huizhi deliberately made it difficult: “Let’s see a no-makeup photo.”
She thought the conversation would end there, but the person actually sent one.
Yun Huizhi instantly became worthless. “From now on, the meaning of my life is waiting for you to come, Older Sister.”

211879.synopsis:
Song Lianzhou transmigrated into an upgrade-style Long Aotian cultivation novel.
The original host was the sect’s noble, bright, and highly powerful senior martial brother, yet he suffered a crushing defeat in the cultivation world grand tournament against an outer sect disciple the male lead, Ye Xisheng and eventually died of melancholy.
The system demanded that he alter this destiny, defeat the male lead, and claim the number one spot.
However, the only two words Song Lianzhou saw in his mind were “defeat.”
Having never dropped below the top three in any exam or competition since childhood, and possessing an obsession with first place bordering on the pathological, Song Lianzhou hailed as the “God of Grinding” declared: This will not do.
Thus, he knocked over the male lead’s spiritual medicine, causing the male lead to look at him gloomily: “How did you know there was poison inside?”
He snatched away the male lead’s mental cultivation manual ahead of time, prompting the male lead to remark: “This manual clashes with my cultivation technique; senior brother is truly thoughtful.”
When the male lead was subjected to the punishment of being thrown off a cliff, Song Lianzhou knew this was a turning point, as the fortuitous opportunity at the bottom of the abyss would allow one to be reborn from the ashes after death and start opening the cheat codes to slap faces thereafter.
Therefore, the exact second before the male lead jumped off the cliff, he hustled and shoved the person to the side: “Step aside.”
Do you even know how to die properly? Let me do it.
Later, the male lead closed in on him step by step: “Senior brother, I never expected your affection toward me to run so deep.”
“I am also fond of you.”
Song Lianzhou: “???”
Ye Xisheng knew that he was actually a character inside a book.
Reborn back to his eighteenth year, he had no remaining desires and only wished to find a place to live in seclusion, far away from the secular world.
Upon opening his eyes for the very first time, he saw a tall and slender youth in cyan robes lowering his gaze slightly to ask: “Are you alright?”
Ye Xisheng’s dead and silent heart suddenly began to beat uncontrollably.
